definition: A technique for applying the visual or stylistic characteristics of one piece of content (such as an artistic style) to another piece of content while preserving its underlying structure or content.
details: Style transfer, originally popularized in the context of neural image style transfer, has since been extended to other modalities like text style transfer, changing tone or formality while preserving underlying meaning.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Style Transfer.
